introduction_markdown: GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD, General Certificate of Education Examination. 0796 INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGIES 1, ADVANCED LEVEL, JUNE 2022. Multiple choice question paper. Duration: one and a half hours. Mobile phones are NOT allowed in the examination room. Use a soft HB pencil throughout the examination. Answer ALL the 50 questions in this examination; all questions carry equal marks. Each question has FOUR suggested answers: A, B, C and D. Decide on which answer is correct, find the number of the question on the Answer Sheet and draw a horizontal line across the letter to join the square brackets for the answer you have chosen. Mark only one answer for each question (if you mark more than one answer, you will score zero for that question). Avoid spending too much time on any one question; if you find a question difficult, move on to the next question and come back to it later. Do all rough work in the booklet, using the blank spaces in the question booklet.
incertitudes: Page de garde vérifiée : GENERAL CERTIFICATE OF EDUCATION BOARD, 0796 INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGIES 1, JUNE 2022, ADVANCED LEVEL, QCM d'une heure et demie, 50 questions de même valeur. Sujet scanné (CamScanner, filigranes gcerevision.com ignorés), 4 pages (page de garde et 3 pages de questions), sans corrigé officiel : toutes les clés sont déduites et les corrigés rédigés. Aucun point imprimé. Le sujet ne mentionne pas l'interdiction de la calculatrice (les instructions imprimées n'en parlent pas).

Les calculs des questions 4, 9 (valeur pour n = 4), 11 (octal vers binaire), 31 (addition hexadécimale 4AC + 9BF = E6B) et 40 (complément à 2 de 1001) ont été refaits par script Python.

Défauts d'impression : coquilles recopiées telles quelles (« make a a web site » en Q35, « prefered » en Q50, « recycler » pour recycle bin en Q42, « Fireguard » et « Data shield » en Q23 qui ne sont pas des termes standard). Q48 : les options A et C sont imprimées avec le même contenu (« database - record - file - field - byte - bit »), toutes deux fausses ; la clé B reste unique. Q9 : l'exposant de l'option B (2^n) et celui de l'option D (n^2) sont petits et tachés sur le scan, lecture retenue 2n / 2^n / n/2 / n^2 ; pour n = 4, 2^n et n^2 valent tous deux 16, la clé B repose sur le cas général. Q11 : l'option B est tachée sur le scan (lue 110011101).

Clés retenues en QCM avec une marge de doute (énoncé flou ou options défendables, notions de manuel) : Q8 (la vitesse du processeur d'un portable ne s'augmente pas par l'utilisateur, d'où RAM), Q12 (fonction ; module défendable), Q20 (traitement en temps réel ; traitement en ligne défendable), Q26 (identification des clients, énoncé peu précis), Q32 (carte son ; les haut-parleurs sont défendables), Q34 (data protection legislation ; data privacy law défendable), Q41 (TIFF ; BMP et PNG sont aussi sans perte).

Converties en questions ouvertes par le relecteur (clé ou options discutables) : 16, 28. Q16 : système expert (B) ou système d'aide à la décision (A) sont tous deux défendables pour la prévision météo ; Q28 : logiciel sur mesure (A) ou logiciel à usage spécifique (D) désignent la même chose selon les manuels. Réponse visée dans chaque corrigé, aucune lettre choisie au hasard.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following is the fastest memory medium in the computer?
questions.corrige_markdown: Memory speed depends on the technology and on how close the memory is to the processor. A hard disk is a mechanical (or flash) backing store and is by far the slowest. ROM is read-only and is not designed for speed. DRAM must be refreshed constantly and is slower than SRAM. **SRAM** (static RAM) keeps each bit in a flip-flop, needs no refresh and has the shortest access time, which is why it is used for cache memory. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Frequently used instructions by the CPU are stored in the:
questions.corrige_markdown: The CPU keeps copies of the instructions and data it uses most often in **cache memory**, a small and very fast memory placed between the processor and the main memory. This avoids the delay of fetching them from RAM again. The hard disk and RAM are too slow for this role, and ROM holds permanent start-up instructions, not the instructions a running program uses most. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The suitable computer to execute many programs for hundreds of users at the same time, performing relatively simple operations and transactions is:
questions.corrige_markdown: A **mainframe** is built for high-volume transaction processing for hundreds or thousands of simultaneous users (banks, airlines, insurance). A supercomputer is built for a few very heavy scientific calculations, not for many simple transactions, and personal computers and microcomputers serve one user. **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The maximum number of characters that can be represented by a computer that operates a 4 bits system is
questions.corrige_markdown: A code of $n$ bits has $2^n$ different bit patterns, and each pattern can stand for one character. For $n = 4$: $2^4 = 16$ patterns (0000 to 1111), so at most 16 characters can be represented. The option 8 comes from the wrong reasoning $2 \times 4$, and 4 is only the number of bits. **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: _____ is a network device that combines multiple signals for transmission on a single channel.
questions.corrige_markdown: A **multiplexer** (MUX) takes several input signals and sends them one after the other, or on different frequencies, over one shared channel. A demultiplexer does the opposite at the receiving end, a router forwards packets between networks, and a modem converts digital signals to analogue signals and back. **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Critical path of the PERT chart is:
questions.corrige_markdown: In a PERT (or critical path) network, every route from the start to the end is a sequence of dependent tasks. The project cannot finish before the **longest** route is finished, so this route is the critical path: any delay on one of its tasks delays the whole project. It has no slack. The shortest or the average path do not determine the project duration. **Answer: C.**

choix.texte: the shortest path to complete the project.
the average path to complete the project.
the path which takes the longest time to complete the project.
the path which takes the shortest time to complete the project.

questions.enonce_markdown: The formal way to close a project is to
questions.corrige_markdown: Formal project closure (the last phase of the project life cycle) ends with **acceptance of the deliverables by the stakeholders** (the client or sponsor), usually by a sign-off. The project manager and the team accepting their own work is not formal acceptance, paying workers and returning tools are only administrative closing tasks, and completing all tasks is a necessary condition but is not the formal act of closure. **Answer: A.**

choix.texte: Get the stakeholders to accept that the project is complete.
The project manager and his workers accepts that the project is complete
Paying all the workers and return all tools
Ensure that all tasks have been executed.

questions.enonce_markdown: A laptop performance can be improved by?
questions.corrige_markdown: Adding RAM is the usual and most effective upgrade of a laptop: with more main memory the system swaps less data to the slow disk, and more programs run smoothly at the same time. The resolution only changes the sharpness of the display, utility software maintains the system (clean-up, antivirus) but does not add resources, and the CPU speed of a laptop is fixed by the processor and cannot normally be increased by the user. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown: An operation code with $n$ bits will imply that there are _____ possible distinct operations.
questions.corrige_markdown: The operation code (opcode) is the part of a machine instruction that says which operation to perform. With $n$ bits there are $2^n$ different bit patterns, hence at most $2^n$ distinct operations. Check with $n = 3$: $2^3 = 8$ patterns (000 to 111) and not $2n = 6$ or $n^2 = 9$. **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The main purpose of a digital certificate is to:
questions.corrige_markdown: A digital certificate, issued by a certification authority, binds a public key to the identity of its owner. Its main purpose is to **authenticate** the sender or the source of a file, a message or a website (and so to allow encryption and digital signatures to be trusted). It is not a way of awarding academic certificates, nor of publishing them or making them hard to copy. **Answer: A.**

choix.texte: Authenticate the source of a file.
Ease award of certificates through Internet.
Make certificates available online for other users to confirm.
To make certificates difficult to reproduce.

questions.enonce_markdown: The binary equivalent of the octal number 625 is
questions.corrige_markdown: Each octal digit is replaced by its 3-bit binary group: $6 = 110$, $2 = 010$, $5 = 101$. Joining the groups gives $110\,010\,101$, that is 110010101. Checking in reverse: $110 = 6$, $010 = 2$, $101 = 5$. The other options give 635, 615 and 605 when regrouped in threes. **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: An operation that is executed a number of times at different places in your algorithm can be extracted out and made into:
questions.corrige_markdown: A block of instructions that is needed at several places is written once and given a name: it becomes a **function** (or subprogram) that is called wherever required. This avoids repetition and makes the algorithm easier to maintain. Iteration and control structures are the building blocks used inside algorithms, not a unit extracted from them. (A module is a larger unit that may contain several functions.) **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A variable type which can conveniently store different elements of the same type under a single name is called
questions.corrige_markdown: An **array** is an indexed collection of elements of the same type stored under one name (for example `marks[1]` to `marks[30]`). A record groups fields of different types, while a queue and a stack are abstract structures with their own access rules (FIFO and LIFO). **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A software subject to copyright that users can download from the Internet and use for free is:
questions.corrige_markdown: **Freeware** is copyrighted software that the author lets users download and use at no cost, without access to the source code and usually without the right to modify or sell it. Shareware is free only for a trial period, then payment is requested; open source software provides the source code and the right to modify it; utility software is a category of programs, not a licence type. **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The use of _____ makes it easier to organize files in a logical way.
questions.corrige_markdown: A **folder** (directory) is a container used to group related files, for example by subject or by year, and folders can be nested in a hierarchy. A file extension only tells the type of a file, a file name identifies one file, and a path only gives the location of a file. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
A system that can predict weather conditions is:

*Options as printed:* A) Decision support system.   B) Expert system.   C) Transaction support system.   D) Geographical Information System.
questions.corrige_markdown:
An **expert system** holds the knowledge of human specialists as rules and facts, and an inference engine applies them to the data entered (pressure, temperature, humidity, wind) to give a forecast; weather forecasting is a standard textbook application, together with medical diagnosis and mineral exploration. A transaction processing system records day-to-day transactions and a GIS stores and displays spatial data on maps. A decision support system could also use weather models, so the wording of the question is not fully exclusive.

**Intended answer: B (Expert system).**

The printed question is not reliable enough to be marked automatically so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.

questions.enonce_markdown: The memory device that holds current date and time on your computer is called:
questions.corrige_markdown: The date and the time are kept by the real-time clock, which is powered by a small battery and stores the BIOS settings in **CMOS** memory on the motherboard, so that they are not lost when the computer is switched off. DRAM and ROM do not keep a running date, and "clock" is a timing circuit, not the memory device that holds the data. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following is a characteristic of broadband?
questions.corrige_markdown: Broadband is a high-capacity, **high-speed**, always-on Internet connection (DSL, cable, fibre, 4G/5G). It is not completely safe from intruders (a firewall is still needed), it is not a dial-up connection, and its cost is fixed by the subscription, not by the day. **Answer: C.**

choix.texte: It has a dial up connection.
Cost varies from day to day.

questions.enonce_markdown: A real-time operating system is used in:
questions.corrige_markdown: A real-time operating system must respond to events within a guaranteed, very short time. The **fuel injection system of an engine** is a typical embedded control application: if the response is late, the engine fails. Print spooling, network services and file management have no such strict deadline. **Answer: D.**

choix.texte: Controlling access to a network printer.
Providing services to all users of the network at the same time.
Managing the access to system files in a computer.
Controlling the fuel injection system of an automobile engine.

questions.enonce_markdown: An airline reservation system is an example of
questions.corrige_markdown: In an airline reservation system a seat that is booked must be marked as taken at once, so that no other agent can sell it. The data are processed immediately and the files are updated at the moment of the transaction: this is **real time processing**. Batch processing collects data and processes it later, and time sharing is the sharing of CPU time among several users. (Booking is also done online, but real time is the classic textbook answer.) **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Data redundancy is a database anomaly that:
questions.corrige_markdown: **Data redundancy** means that the same piece of data is stored several times in the database (for example a customer's address repeated in every order record). It wastes storage and causes update anomalies and inconsistencies. Normalisation removes it. **Answer: B.**

choix.texte: deletes data that has not been used for long.
Forbids data of a particular type.
Selects data that occur too often.

questions.enonce_markdown: Why is it necessary for an organization to adopt a good password policy?
questions.corrige_markdown: A password policy (minimum length, mix of characters, regular change, no sharing) makes it hard for an intruder to guess or steal a password, and so **protects files and systems against unauthorised use**. It does not aim at making sharing, connection or access easier, since stronger passwords actually add a barrier. **Answer: C.**

choix.texte: Easy sharing of files across the network.
Easy connection of computer to a network.
To protect files against unauthorized use.
Easy access of files on a computer.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which one of the following monitors incoming network traffic to prevent unauthorized attacks?
questions.corrige_markdown: A **firewall** (hardware or software) examines the packets entering and leaving a network and blocks those that do not follow the security rules. "Data guard", "fireguard" and "data shield" are not standard network security devices. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A network topology whose components are connected physically to the cable trunk is:
questions.corrige_markdown: In a **bus topology** all the stations are attached (by taps or T-connectors) to one common cable called the backbone or trunk. In a star topology every device connects to a central hub or switch, in a ring each device is linked to two neighbours, and in a mesh devices have many point-to-point links. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The logic gate with one input and one output is:
questions.corrige_markdown: The **NOT gate** (inverter) has a single input $A$ and a single output $\overline{A}$. AND, XOR and NAND are two-input gates (they may have more inputs but never fewer than two). **Answer: A.**
themes: ict logic gates and boolean algebra

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following is NOT a feature of electronic commerce?
questions.corrige_markdown: E-commerce features include advertising of goods with easy price comparison, fast processing of transactions and availability around the clock. Customers are **not necessarily identified before buying**: a buyer can browse and compare anonymously, and in face-to-face trade the seller is the one who sees the customer, while online the identification is only needed at payment or account creation. This is the statement that is not a defining feature. **Answer: C.**

choix.texte: Goods can be advertised and prices compared
Services are available 24 hours a day.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following describes Instant Messaging?
questions.corrige_markdown: Instant messaging (WhatsApp, Messenger, Skype chat) lets two or more users exchange short text messages that are delivered at once, so the conversation takes place in **real time**. Fax uses the telephone network, e-mail is store-and-forward and not immediate, and voice over the Internet is VoIP. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
Quality Developer is a company that writes programs to do specific jobs for other companies. These programs are called?

*Options as printed:* A) Custom-purpose software   B) General-purpose software   C) Off-the-shelf software   D) Special-purpose software
questions.corrige_markdown:
Software written by a company to the specification of one client, for one specific job of that client, is **custom-written (bespoke, tailor-made) software**. General-purpose and off-the-shelf software are made for many users and bought ready-made. The term "special-purpose software" (a program for one particular task such as payroll) is also used for this kind of program, which makes the printed options overlap.

**Intended answer: A (Custom-purpose software).**

The printed question is not reliable enough to be marked automatically so it is left open for self-assessment instead of being auto-marked.

questions.enonce_markdown: One important role of interface in design is:
questions.corrige_markdown: A good interface sits between the user and the system and **hides the complexity** of the underlying machine behind simple screens, icons and menus, so that the user can work without knowing how the machine does it. Presenting menus is only one technique, an interface does not teach the operation of the machine, and decoding of information is not its role. **Answer: D.**

choix.texte: It teaches users how to operate the machine
It makes decoding of information easier.
It hides the complexities of the machine.

questions.enonce_markdown: The stream of bits used to control the flow of data in asynchronous communication is called.
questions.corrige_markdown: In asynchronous transmission, there is no common clock between sender and receiver. Each character is therefore framed by a **start bit** (which signals the beginning and lets the receiver synchronise) and one or more **stop bits** (which mark the end). Parity bits are used for error detection, and a clock is used in synchronous transmission. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: $4AC_{16} + 9BF_{16}$ is equal to:
questions.corrige_markdown:
Add column by column from the right, with $C = 12$, $A = 10$, $B = 11$, $F = 15$, $E = 14$.

- Units: $C + F = 12 + 15 = 27 = 16 + 11$, write $B$, carry 1.
- Sixteens: $A + B + 1 = 10 + 11 + 1 = 22 = 16 + 6$, write 6, carry 1.
- Two-fifty-sixes: $4 + 9 + 1 = 14$, write $E$.

Result: $E6B_{16}$. Check in decimal: $4AC_{16} = 1196$, $9BF_{16} = 2495$, sum $= 3691 = E6B_{16}$. **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The quality of sound from a speaker is best determined by
questions.corrige_markdown: The sound card converts the digital audio data into analogue signals (digital-to-analogue converter) and amplifies them before they reach the speaker. Its sampling resolution and its signal-to-noise ratio set the quality of the sound that the speaker receives, so the **sound card** is the component that best determines the quality. The media player and the processor only supply data, while the speaker reproduces the signal it is given. (The speaker itself also influences what is heard, so the wording is not perfectly exclusive.) **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following about an end user license agreement is true?
questions.corrige_markdown: An end user licence agreement (EULA) does not transfer ownership: the user only receives the **right to use** the software under conditions, typically to install and run it on a specified number of computers. Copying for sale and modifying the code are forbidden unless the licence says so (open source licences do). **Answer: D.**

choix.texte: It gives full ownership of the software to the user.
It gives the user the exclusive right to copy and sell the software to others.
It gives the user the right to modify the software.
It gives the user the right to install and run the software on a specified number of computers.

questions.enonce_markdown: The rules governing the rights of data subjects are called?
questions.corrige_markdown: A data subject is the person to whom personal data relate. The rules that give data subjects rights (to access, correct and object to the use of their data) and impose duties on those who hold the data are called **data protection legislation** (for example the Data Protection Act or the GDPR). Copyright law protects authors' works, and "data publicity law" does not exist. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A malicious attempt such as to make a web site unavailable to its intended users can be termed?
questions.corrige_markdown: A **denial-of-service (DoS) attack** floods a server or website with requests so that legitimate users can no longer reach it. Hacking is unauthorised access, spamming is the mass sending of unwanted messages and computer fraud is the use of a computer to obtain money or goods dishonestly. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A tool in the Internet that assist users to locate resources in the World Wide Web is
questions.corrige_markdown: A **search engine** (Google, Bing) indexes web pages and finds the ones that match the keywords typed by the user. A web browser only displays the pages, a protocol is a set of communication rules and e-mail is a message service. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown: Which one of the following is a good password policy for an organization?
questions.corrige_markdown: A good policy requires passwords to be **changed regularly**, so that a stolen or guessed password is only useful for a short time (and to be long and complex). Passwords that are never changed or that have fewer than four characters or digits are easy to guess or to crack. **Answer: A.**

choix.texte: All passwords are made up of less than four characters.
All passwords are made up of less than four numbers.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which one of the following statements about Internet connection services is true?
questions.corrige_markdown: Broadband is an **always-on** connection: no number has to be dialled each time. Dial-up is slow (about 56 kbit/s), so B is false; it also occupies the telephone line and must be re-established for every session, so D is false. With ADSL a filter lets the same telephone line be used for calls and data at the same time, so C is false. **Answer: A.**

choix.texte: Broadband connections are always-on while your computer is switched on.
Dial-up connections are usually faster than broadband connections.
You cannot use your telephone line to make calls while using a broadband connection.
Dial-up connections are always-on while your computer is switched on.

questions.enonce_markdown: One function of an operating system is:
questions.corrige_markdown: An operating system manages the resources of the computer: **it controls the allocation of hardware** (processor time, memory, disk space, input and output devices) among the running programs. Retrieving information from a database is done by a DBMS, booting is started by the BIOS or firmware (the operating system is loaded by it), and processing of data is done by application programs. **Answer: B.**

choix.texte: It retrieve information from a database
It controls the allocation of hardware
It is used for booting the computer.

questions.enonce_markdown: The 2's complement of the binary expression 1001 is
questions.corrige_markdown:
To find the 2's complement of a binary number, invert all the bits and add 1.

- Invert 1001: $0110$.
- Add 1: $0110 + 1 = 0111$.

The result is 0111 (option C, 0110, is only the 1's complement). Check: $1001 + 0111 = 10000$, so the sum is zero in 4 bits. **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A format that best guarantees file quality is:
questions.corrige_markdown: JPEG uses lossy compression, which loses information at each save, so it does not guarantee quality. BMP, PNG and TIFF are lossless; among them **TIFF** is the format used in printing, scanning and archiving because it keeps full quality (high colour depth, layers, no loss) and is the standard for professional image work. BMP is uncompressed but poorly supported for high-end work, and PNG is mainly for web graphics. The question is not perfectly exclusive, TIFF is the usual textbook choice. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The recycler in the computer that recovers deleted files is an example of:
questions.corrige_markdown: The recycle bin is a small tool of the operating system that keeps deleted files so that they can be restored. Programs that maintain or manage the computer (backup, disk clean-up, antivirus, recycle bin) are **utility software**. Application software helps the user to produce work such as documents, and bespoke software is written for one client. **Answer: D.**

questions.enonce_markdown: An abstract data structure that use FIFO is:
questions.corrige_markdown: FIFO means first in, first out: the first item added is the first one removed, as in a queue of people. A **queue** works this way. A stack is LIFO (last in, first out); a list and an array are not defined by such a rule (and an array is not an abstract structure of this kind). **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: _____ is a property of a programming language.
questions.corrige_markdown: Every programming language has its own **syntax**: the set of rules that says how statements must be written (keywords, punctuation, structure), as well as its semantics. An interface and an editor belong to the programming environment, and comments are an optional element of programs, not a property of the language. **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The appropriate action to take to determine why a software is failing to give the required result is
questions.corrige_markdown: **Debugging** is the process of locating and correcting the errors (bugs) in a program that produces wrong results, using trace tables, breakpoints and test data. Requirements analysis and the feasibility study come before the development, and compilation only translates the program (it reports syntax errors but not logic errors). **Answer: A.**

questions.enonce_markdown: A foreign key in a relation refers to a:
questions.corrige_markdown: A **foreign key** is a field (or fields) in one table whose values match the **primary key of another table**; it creates the link (relationship) between the two tables and enforces referential integrity. For example `CustomerID` in an Orders table refers to the primary key of the Customers table. **Answer: A.**

choix.texte: Key that is imported from other database
Key field that can replace the primary key
Field with no relation with other keys.

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following is the best way to maintain a good posture when working with a computer?
questions.corrige_markdown: Good posture depends on the workstation as a whole: the screen at eye level, the keyboard at elbow height, an adjustable chair with back support, and the feet flat on the floor. The option that covers all these points is making sure that **the computer, desk and chair are positioned correctly** (ergonomics). The other options are only partial measures (frequent breaks reduce strain but do not set the posture). **Answer: D.**

choix.texte: Make sure your feet touch the floor
Make sure that your computer, desk and chair are positioned correctly

questions.enonce_markdown: Which of the following is the descending order of data hierarchy
questions.corrige_markdown: From the largest unit to the smallest: a **database** contains **files** (tables); a file contains **records**; a record contains **fields**; a field is made of **bytes** (characters); a byte is made of 8 **bits**. This gives database - file - record - field - byte - bit. Options A and C put the record above the file and are wrong (they are printed with the same content), and D puts the byte above the field. **Answer: B.**

questions.enonce_markdown: JavaScript can be embedded in an HTML page between?
questions.corrige_markdown: JavaScript code is placed between the **`<script>` and `</script>`** tags (in the head or the body of the page, or loaded with the `src` attribute). `<style>` holds CSS, `<html>` encloses the whole document and `<body>` contains the displayed content. **Answer: C.**

questions.enonce_markdown: The technique preferred to transfer large amount of data to and from a memory in a short time is:
questions.corrige_markdown: With programmed I/O the processor waits and copies every word itself, and with interrupt-driven I/O it still handles each transfer. **Direct Memory Access (DMA)** lets a DMA controller move a whole block of data directly between the device and the memory without using the CPU for each word, which makes large transfers fast and frees the processor. **Answer: C.**
